summary_en: iBow (iBow Co., Ltd., represented by founder Nakano Taketo) to acquire 60,000 eWeLL shares from shareholder Nakano Taketo (eWeLL CEO) on 2026-06-17. Post-acquisition: 860,000 shares held; 5.64% voting rights. iBow intends long-term stable ownership. Triggers regulatory disclosure under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act article 167(1) and ordinance article 31.
title_en: Notice regarding share acquisition constituting an act equivalent to a tender offer as prescribed by ordinance
translation_en_brief: eWeLL Co., Ltd. disclosed on 2026-06-17 that iBow Co., Ltd. (represented by founder Nakano Taketo) is acquiring 60,000 eWeLL shares directly from shareholder Nakano Taketo (eWeLL's CEO) on the same date. Following this acquisition, iBow will hold 860,000 shares, representing 5.64% of total voting rights (based on 152,408 total voting units as of 2025-12-31). The acquisition triggers regulatory disclosure thresholds under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act article 167(1) and ordinance article 31, as post-acquisition voting rights exceed 5%. iBow stated its intention to maintain these shares as a stable long-term holder. This acquisition follows an earlier share purchase announced 2026-04-04.
